FACT_ID: sec15-R01 | anchor: A01
Skills-test drivers must leave parking assist and cruise control off [A01]
Why it matters: group adas; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec15-R02
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-R02 | anchor: A01
Assistance systems only support the driver, never replace attention [A01]
Why it matters: group adas; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec15-R01
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0100]

FACT_ID: sec15-R03 | anchor: A80
For buses, recreational vehicles and trailers at least eighty inches wide, clearance lighting includes two amber front lamps and an amber lamp on each side, plus two red rear lamps and a red lamp on each side toward the rear. These lamps must be visible at night from five hundred feet [A80].
Why it matters: group lights; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec15-R04
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-R04 | anchor: A81
Except for motorcycles, a vehicle needs at least two working white headlights, with one on either side. High beams must reach three hundred fifty feet, and low beams one hundred feet [A81].
Why it matters: group lights; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec15-R03
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0101]

FACT_ID: sec15-R05 | anchor: A82
Two red tail and stop lamps belong at the rear, visible in ordinary sunlight from five hundred feet behind. Motorcycles and certain vehicles built before nineteen fifty-six may instead have one tail and stop lamp [A82].
Why it matters: group lights; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec15-R06
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0102]

FACT_ID: sec15-R06 | anchor: A83
Rear turn signals consist of two lamps colored red, yellow or amber; the two front lamps may be white, yellow or amber. They must be visible in normal sunlight from one hundred feet. Vehicles built before nineteen fifty-three need no turn signals if their width is less than eighty inches [A83].
Why it matters: group signals; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec15-R05
